hook.say: US state against US state. Which is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each. They get harder!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is the biggest: Texas, Alaska or California?
questions.fact: Alaska is bigger than Texas, California and Montana combined.
questions.sayAnswer: Alaska! It is bigger than Texas, California and Montana combined.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Oregon or Washington?
questions.fact: Oregon is almost 40% bigger than Washington state.
questions.sayAnswer: Oregon! It is almost forty percent bigger than Washington state.

questions.q: Which is bigger: North Dakota or South Dakota?
questions.fact: South Dakota is about 9% bigger than North Dakota.
questions.sayAnswer: South Dakota! It is about nine percent bigger than North Dakota.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Arizona or New Mexico?
questions.fact: New Mexico is about 7% bigger than Arizona.
questions.sayAnswer: New Mexico! It is about seven percent bigger than Arizona.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Nevada or Colorado?
questions.fact: Nevada is about 6% bigger than Colorado.
questions.sayAnswer: Nevada! It is about six percent bigger than Colorado.
